description.value:
You worked as a licensed protector, standing between your charge and whatever threat came looking for them. Maybe your family served a powerful patron for generations, maybe you owe a life debt to the person you once guarded — either way, your loyalty was never in question, and neither was your willingness to act on it.

Years spent scanning rooms for exits and reading crowds for trouble have left you constantly, quietly alert, even when you're the one who needs watching over now.

toolProficiencies: Your choice of demolitions kit, disguise kit, or security kit
system.equipment: A set of clandestine clothes, a tool kit matching your training, a trauma kit, and a belt pouch containing 75 credits.
